messages.subject: using the weighted likelihood in TMB
messages.subject_clean: using the weighted likelihood in TMB
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am currently coding the Laplace approximation manually in TMB  and multiplying such approximation by the sampling weights.

It works fine in most occasions  but for some weights,  gradient becomes NaN during optimization  which leads to quite inaccurate parameter estimates.
I am wondering why this happens for some set of sampling weights.  Originally I thought the sampling weights are too large and tried reducing the weights,  but this still happens for small weights.

I am multiplying the likelihood by the sampling weight as below.  So I am multiplying each individual likelihood contribution (after Laplace approximation)  by the individual sampling weight.
nll += weight  * obj.eval_nldens<Type>(a1);

I would appreciate any kind of help. Thanks.
